scientific.integrity: The lower bound is a symbolic consequence of the exact Schur-multiplier formula for finite abelian groups. The upper bound is taken from Holt's explicit elementary-abelian construction, with the \(p^k=4\) exception checked in the source. The bundled finite enumeration is only a consistency test.
scientific.limitations: The theorem treats elementary-abelian target multipliers only. It does not optimize group order, nilpotency class, Fitting height, or generator number, and it does not classify minimum derived length for general finite abelian targets.

title: Exact derived-length threshold for elementary-abelian Schur multipliers
